changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_sync_runs ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, connection_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "trigger" VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, stage VARCHAR(64), accounts_seen INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, transactions_new INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, transactions_updated INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pending_replaced INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rows_skipped INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, to_review INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error_class VARCHAR(32), error_code VARCHAR(64), error_message TEXT, requested_by VARCHAR(255), created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_sync_runs_trigger CHECK ("trigger" IN ('CALLBACK', 'SCHEDULE', 'MANUAL', 'CONNECT')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_sync_runs_status CHECK (status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED')) ); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_sync_runs_connection_started ON bank_sync_runs (connection_id, started_at DESC); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_bank_sync_runs_one_active ON bank_sync_runs (connection_id) WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING');

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_sync_run_accounts ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, run_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_sync_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, transactions_new INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, transactions_updated INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pending_replaced INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(16), error_code VARCHAR(64), created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT uq_bank_sync_run_accounts_run_account UNIQUE (run_id, account_id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_sync_run_accounts_account ON bank_sync_run_accounts (account_id);

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_transactions ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, channel VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, origin VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, external_id VARCHAR(64), system_source VARCHAR(32), system_source_id BIGINT, status VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(19,2) NOT NULL, currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL, operation_date DATE NOT NULL, booking_date DATE, title TEXT, counterparty_name VARCHAR(255), counterparty_iban VARCHAR(34), counterparty_key VARCHAR(300), provider_category VARCHAR(64), counterparty_raw JSONB, provider_payload JSONB, link_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNLINKED', ignored_reason TEXT, ignored_by VARCHAR(255), ignored_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, reviewed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, reviewed_by VARCHAR(255), ai_classified_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, ingested_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), first_sync_run_id BIGINT REFERENCES bank_sync_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_by_user VARCHAR(255), created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_channel CHECK (channel IN ('BANK', 'CASH')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_origin CHECK (origin IN ('BANK_FEED', 'MANUAL', 'SYSTEM')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_channel_origin CHECK ( (channel = 'BANK' AND origin = 'BANK_FEED') OR (channel = 'CASH' AND origin IN ('MANUAL', 'SYSTEM')) ), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_feed_external CHECK (origin <> 'BANK_FEED' OR external_id IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_system_source CHECK ( system_source IS NULL OR system_source IN ('PAYROLL_PAYOUT', 'PROCUREMENT_CASH') ), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_system_refs CHECK ( origin <> 'SYSTEM' OR (system_source IS NOT NULL AND system_source_id IS NOT NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'POSTED')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_cash_posted CHECK (channel <> 'CASH' OR status = 'POSTED'), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_amount_non_zero CHECK (amount <> 0), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_posted_booking CHECK (status <> 'POSTED' OR booking_date IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_link_status CHECK (link_status IN ( 'IGNORED', 'LINKED', 'AUTO_LINKED', 'PARTIALLY_LINKED', 'SUGGESTED', 'UNLINKED' )), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transactions_ignored_reason CHECK ((link_status = 'IGNORED') = (ignored_reason IS NOT NULL)) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_bank_transactions_account_external ON bank_transactions (account_id, external_id) WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_bank_transactions_system_source ON bank_transactions (system_source, system_source_id) WHERE system_source IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transactions_booking_date ON bank_transactions (booking_date DESC); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transactions_account_booking ON bank_transactions (account_id, booking_date); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transactions_link_status ON bank_transactions (link_status); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transactions_channel ON bank_transactions (channel); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transactions_counterparty_key ON bank_transactions (counterparty_key); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transactions_counterparty_iban ON bank_transactions (counterparty_iban);
